purpose: Correct the GitHub Pages acceptance route in the listing-standards publication plan to the repository artifact path used by the existing Pages deployment.

authorization.scope: repair a deterministic publication-gate path discovered during the authorized release
excludes: production-server refresh before the corrected gate passes
DSH Profile, package, restart, or runtime mutation

acceptedRoute.reason: GitHub Pages preserves marketplace subpaths while production nginx serves marketplace as the site root

gates: origin/main must still equal the bound base Commit before push
the two public HTTP statuses must be re-read before commit
the expected SHA-256 must match the corrected plan
required pull-request checks must pass before merge
manually dispatch the Pages workflow after merge because this correction changes only docs/ops
the new Pages release manifest must match the correction merge Commit before any production refresh

rollback.repository: revert the correction pull request through an auditable pull request
rollback.pages: retain the last successful artifact if the manual workflow fails
rollback.production: no production server is mutated by this correction plan
